name: flow_copy_link_official_only
description: A party's link, play/?join=CODE, always opens the official server, so the strip offers copy link, and + invite copies the link, only for a party there. A party on a LAN server (or a server of one's own) shows copy code alone, and + invite copies the code: a friend who opened the link would land on the official server, where that code is nobody's party or someone else's. The fake sequencer in lobby mode stands in for both servers (tests/net/loopback_hub.gd names its official server play.loopback.test).

steps.msg: a code joins on the official server
the party lives on the official server
the strip offers copy code and copy link
the link names the party's code
offline, no party: no link, and + invite opens Join

steps.assert: not Session.on_official() and node('Place').text == 'LAN · 192.168.1.20' and node('Code').text == 'K7Q-4M'
steps.msg: the same code, now a party on a LAN server

steps.assert: node('CodeBox').visible and node('CopyCode').visible and not node('CopyLink').visible
steps.msg: the strip offers copy code alone
no link leads here: + invite copies the code
